name: DHC-6 Twin Otter
summary: Rugged STOL twin turboprop used for skydiving, bush, island and polar work; the USAF Academy flies a few as the UV-18.

engines: Two PT6A turboprops mounted on the wing leading edge, with three-blade props
fuselage: Long, slab-sided boxy fuselage with a long pointed baggage nose (short on Series 100)
Fixed tricycle gear, or floats or skis
tail: Conventional low tail with a tall fin and prominent dorsal fillet

tellTales: Twin turboprops on a straight, strut-braced high wing
Fixed landing gear on a boxy twin
Long pointed nose ahead of a slab-sided cabin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Twin Otter is much smaller with fixed gear, wing struts and a low tail; the ATR has retractable gear, no struts and a T-tail.
The Twin Otter has two wing-mounted engines; the Caravan has a single engine in the nose.
